# Vendored: impeccable DESIGN.md parser

`design-parser.mjs` is copied unchanged from the impeccable skill
(`pbakaus/impeccable`, skill version 4.1.3) as vendored in Spellkave at
`.agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/lib/design-parser.mjs`. The skill declares
the Apache License 2.0; the licence text is in `LICENSE`.

ui-lab uses it to parse the root `DESIGN.md` at build and test time.
